summary: Black Hawk Acquisition Corp, a Cayman SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a September 22, 2026 OTC equity prepaid forward with Meteora Select Trading Opportunities Master LP covering up to 1,350,000 shares tied to its previously announced business combination with Vesicor Therapeutics. The initial forward price equals the per-share trust redemption price, funded from the trust at closing, with recycled open-market shares and additional subscription shares and dilution adjustment. The deal would domesticate Black Hawk into Delaware PubCo Vesicor Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. Terms include a prepayment net of amounts and no closing date. Watch redemption levels and financing mechanics.
